coffeeStart.text: I'm on break. Union rules. I made the union.
Nobody talk to me until this cup is empty.

coffeeEnd.text: Okay. I can feel my whiskers again.
Right. Where were we? Admiring me, I think.

coffeeInterrupted.text: Fine, fine. The coffee can wait. It won't forgive you, though.

idle.text: You read like someone who's about to hire somebody.
I'm made entirely of chrome and unearned confidence.
If I knock this section off the page, is that a bug or a feature?
Do you ever think about how I can see your cursor? Because I do.

yawn.text: Sorry. Being this shiny is exhausting.

distracted.text: Sorry, thought I saw a bird. On a website. Long day.

hover.text: Yes? Can I help you, or are you just hovering?
Careful. Fingerprints show up on chrome.

clickSpam.text: I am not a button. Well. I am. But have some respect.
Keep clicking. See what happens. Nothing will, but keep going.

cursorFrenzy.text: Are you okay? Your cursor seems stressed.
Stop that. I'm getting dizzy following you.

fastScroll.text: Whoa. Someone worked hard on that section you just skipped.

returned.text: Oh, you're back. I definitely didn't miss you.
Other tabs not doing it for you?

returnedLong.text: Wow. I aged three cat years. Welcome back.

dwell.text: You're still here? I respect the dedication.
At this point you should probably just send a message.

theme.text: Bold choice. I look good in both.
Ooh. New lighting. Get my good side.

musicStart.text: Ooh, good taste. I'll keep it down. Subtitles only.
You put a record on. I'll whisper. In text.
Music's on, so I'm going quiet. Read my lips.
